title: KubeCon 2026 - travel & expenses scratchpad
content:
Quick notes / checklist for KubeCon 2026 (San Diego) - organizing travel, expenses, vendor contacts, and booth logistics. Mostly reminders to self; will clean up and share with team.

Dates: May 12-15, 2026 (expo May 13-15). Travel days: fly in Tue May 11 evening or Wed morning depending on cheaper flight. Fly out Sun May 16.

Budget & approvals:
- Reserved budget: $3,000 per attendee for travel+hotel (pre-approved by People Ops for eng team).
- Booth budget: $8k (shipping + AV + furniture). Need PO for AV vendor before April 10.
- Per diem: follow Redwood travel policy - meals up to $75/day, alcohol allowed with business purpose and < $40.
- Use company travel card (ending ****1234) for vendor charges and hotel where possible. Personal reimbursements: submit receipts in Expensify within 7 days of travel.

Travel logistics:
- Flights: prefer direct if under $500. Search SFO-SAN. Possible carriers: Alaska, United. Tentative: depart SFO 2026-05-11 6:30pm, return 2026-05-16 7:00pm.
- Hotel: San Diego Convention Center area - booked 4 rooms at Marina Tower (block under Redwood Inference) - confirmation#: MT-9241. Group contact: Maria Lopez (hotel events) maria.lopez@marinatower.com, +1-619-555-0123.
- Ground transport: rideshare to/from airport. For booth shipments, coordinate hotel loading dock times.

Booth & AV:
- Booth: 10x20 island, booth vendor: ExpoPro (contact: Carlos Mendez, carlos@expopro.com, +1-619-555-0987). Need final layout by Apr 20.
- AV: basic package included; ordered extra 2x monitors + sound. AV vendor invoice due on delivery day - need PO.
- Shipping: crate dimensions 48x30x36, weight 220lbs. Ship to: San Diego Convention Center, ATT: Jordan Kim / Redwood Inference, Booth 2203. Carrier: FedEx Freight (account on file). Tracker TBA.

Contacts & vendors (save):
- ExpoPro (booth + shipping): Carlos Mendez, carlos@expopro.com, +1-619-555-0987
- Marina Tower (hotel group): Maria Lopez, maria.lopez@marinatower.com, +1-619-555-0123
- AV: SoundWave Events, av@sw-events.com, acct mgr: Lina Park, +1-619-555-0456
- Badge pickup / registration: KubeCon registration desk; exhibitor check-in opens May 12 at 10:00am. Exhibitor contact: kubecon-exhibits@cncf.io

Expense tracking (my notes):
- Card txns: hotel, flights, AV, shipping, meals.
- Expense codes: TRVL-KC (travel), BOOTH-KC (booth costs), MKT-OPS (promo swag). Add correct code on each Expensify receipt.
- Receipts: take photos immediately; upload to Expensify under policy "KubeCon2026".
- Pre-approval required: any swag over $500 needs manager ok (cc Priya).

Day-by-day rough plan (subject to change):
- Tue May 11: travel in; evening team dinner (reserve table for 8) - maybe Born & Raised or local place near Gaslamp.
- Wed May 12: booth build day; AV test; badge pickup; evening partner mixer (invites to be confirmed).
- Thu May 13: expo day 1 - demos, capture leads, schedule customer meetings.
- Fri May 14: expo day 2 + talk (Jordan 2:00pm) - finalize slides and laptop adapter (bring Thunderbolt USB-C + HDMI).
- Sat May 15: expo day 3, teardown after 4pm.
- Sun May 16: travel home.

To-dos (quick):
- [ ] Confirm flights & add to Concur (by Feb 25)
- [ ] Submit PO for AV to finance (by Apr 10) - contact Lina for invoice details
- [ ] Finalize booth layout with ExpoPro (by Apr 20)
- [ ] Order swag: stickers (2k), postcards (1k), hoodies (30) - get quote from SwagWorks by Mar 15
- [ ] Reserve dinner spot for Tue May 11 (8 people) - check group menu/pricing
- [ ] Confirm hotel rooming list with Maria (by Apr 20)
- [ ] Schedule PR/press outreach with marketing (reach out to Priya)

Receipts/examples (notes to self):
- Hotel invoice needs: company tax ID, PO# on folio. Ask Maria to add PO MT-PO-2203.
- AV invoice: line items should match PO exactly to speed payment.

Reimbursements process (reminder):
- Upload receipts to Expensify tagged "KubeCon2026". Expensify policy routes to finance for approval.
- If any vendor asks to bill personal card, avoid if possible; escalate to People Ops.

Misc notes / packing list:
- Demo laptop, charger, HDMI adapter, clicker, dongles, privacy screen, backup SSD with demo VM, dongle for ethernet if needed.
- Business cards (2 boxes), sticker sheets, pop-up banner, table runner with Redwood logo.
- First-aid kit + toolkit (screwdriver, gaffer tape, zip ties).

Post-show follow-ups:
- Export leads from lead capture tool, upload to Salesforce under campaign KubeCon2026.
- Send thank-you notes to partners (Carlos, Maria, Lina).
- Expense report due within 7 days after travel.

Open questions / WIP:
- Do we want a customer dinner on Thu night? If yes, budget + invite list.
- Confirm if we qualify for FedEx discounted booth shipping through ExpoPro (need account setup).
- Who is the backup contact if I am on stage during teardown? (Avery offered to handle).

Notes to self: prioritize PO for AV and final layout with ExpoPro - these are blockers for shipping and on-site setup.

--- end scratchpad (will tidy up and turn into shared checklist once things are confirmed).
